title: Move continuation-only boundary
goal: Classify every move proof and product row by behavior, remove or relabel non-continuation rows from product move claims, and make future move work focus only on modeled live-state continuation.
problemStatement: The move surface currently mixes continuation with reexec, resource reconstruction, and refusal evidence, which makes product move claims misleading.
solutionStatement: Create a checked continuation-only boundary so product move claims apply only to modeled live-state continuation and all non-continuation rows are clearly labeled outside that product claim.
technicalStatement: Build a machine-readable classification ledger, update routing/docs/API/help and coverage guards, and validate that non-continuation rows cannot be presented as product move continuation.

tasks.solutionStatement: Create a complete classification ledger for move proof and product rows using continuation, resource-reconstruction, reexec, or refusal.
tasks.technicalStatement: Read the smoke matrix, generic inventory, productization subsets, retained plans, routing source, docs, and API references, then write a JSON ledger with one class and evidence fields for each row.
